Hi Alicia / Tom 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have aligned next steps for a steering committee with your exec sponsors:

- Decision criteria we heard: latency under 200ms p95 for customer-facing recommendations, strong data isolation (VPC + per-customer keying), and a predictable cost model for scaling to 5M monthly inference requests.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Tom Reed (CFO, economic buyer), Priya N. (CISO, security), Sandra L. (Procurement), Ekrem Y. (VP Eng, technical sponsor).
- Current blockers: procurement needs an initial SLA + insurance confirmation; security team wants an evidence pack (SOC2 scope, audit logs, data retention controls).

Proposed next step: a 60-minute steering committee meeting with your execs + our executive sponsor so we can confirm the mutual action plan and sign off on the procurement timeline. I attached a draft agenda and a starter MAP.

Would next week (Tue 6/16 or Wed 6/17) work for a 60-min slot? If you can share the primary goal for the meeting (contract signature, security Q&A, or technical runbook), we'll tailor the agenda.

Thanks  Ill loop in our solutions engineer for technical prep once we lock the slot.
